title.narrative: Bangladesh Power System Enhancement and Efficiency Improvement Project -Additional Financing

description.narrative: The proposed additional financing will yield expansion of Output 3 (distribution network in rural areas of Bangladesh improved) of the original project. Over 46,000 km (Original: 38,000 km) of 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities rehabilitated, and over 16,000 km (Original: 12,000 km) of 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities will be constructed. An updated design and monitoring framework is in Attachment 2.

Status of Implementation Progress: Till now, 28,777 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities has been rehabilitated.Till now, 11,388 km 33 and 11 kV distribution lines and associated facilities constructed .351 BPL consumers including 35% women already trained on selected business.1585 newly electrified consumer already trained on safe, efficient & productive use of electricityTariff petition has been annually submitted by PGCB, DESCO and BREB .2 studies are ongoing for 4 solar and wind project development.Consulting firm is recruited under Grant 9190. Women friendly measures and activities are ongoing.GIS mapping scope is being implemented for NESCO. Consultant recruitment process is ongoing under Loan 3523. BREB's GIS scope is being implemented under World Bank financing.Training of women employee on GIS mapping is being implemented for BREB under Grant 9190.
